label: Google Calendar
description: A calendar of a Google account, as the Google Calendar connector reads it. Read only; its events are connected to it.

title.description: The calendar's name, as the account shows it: the account's own name for it where it set one.

calendar_id.description: The calendar's Google id. The account's primary calendar is named by its address, not by the word primary.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the calendar. An event that names no zone of its own, and an all-day event, takes it.

access_role.description: What the account may do on the calendar: owner and writer calendars are read by default, and reader calendars only where the connector is told to.

primary.description: Whether this is the account's primary calendar.

color.description: The calendar's color as the account shows it, as a hex code such as #9fe1e7.
